request.style: English, Baroque oratorio aria, a solo contralto voice with long sorrowful phrases, string orchestra and harpsichord continuo, slow sarabande pulse, E flat major turning minor, deeply sad, 3/4, 54 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He was despised and rejected by men
A man of sorrows, acquainted with grief
And as one from whom men hide their faces
He was despised, and we esteemed him not

[Chorus]
Surely he has borne our griefs
And carried our sorrows

[Verse]
He was pierced for our transgressions
He was crushed for our iniquities
Upon him was the chastisement that brought us peace
And by his wounds we are healed

[Chorus]
Surely he has borne our griefs
And carried our sorrows
